diagnosis.means: Purchasing is over-ordering, or storage and FEFO discipline has broken down.
diagnosis.fix: Reduce order frequency for perishables and audit the walk-in temperature log.

by_category.means: Purchasing is over-ordering, or storage and FEFO discipline has broken down.
by_category.fix: Reduce order frequency for perishables and audit the walk-in temperature log.

by_category.means: Trim beyond the standard yield. Points at poor-quality produce (over-ripe, bruised, wrong size) or a skill gap in the prep team.
by_category.fix: Run a yield study: weigh edible yield before and after prep, then compare against the standard yield on the item master.

by_category.means: Purchasing is over-ordering, or storage and FEFO discipline has broken down.
by_category.fix: Reduce order frequency for perishables and audit the walk-in temperature log.

by_category.means: The prep forecast is inaccurate -- the kitchen is cooking more than the day demands.
by_category.fix: Track covers-per-day by day of week and build a par production sheet so the kitchen cooks to demand, not to habit.

by_category.means: Batches lost in cooking -- usually over-boiling, burning or holding too long.
by_category.fix: Check batch sizes and holding times; cook in smaller, more frequent batches.
Check decanting practice and container suitability at the station producing it.

by_category.means: Recipe not being followed, or unclear recipe documentation.
by_category.fix: Re-brief the section and check the recipe card is legible and at the station.

by_category.means: Trim beyond the standard yield. Points at poor-quality produce or a prep skill gap.

by_category.means: Standard prep yield. Already charged into the plate cost, so it carries no rupee value here -- counting it again would double-charge it.
